scope: Z^2 under translations, arbitrary pieces in a finite partition.
Triangular lattice under translations semidirect D6 (order twelve), arbitrary pieces in a finite partition.
excluded_claims: Universal theorem for arbitrary subsets of the Euclidean plane.
Literal existence of counting-nonmeasurable subsets of a countable lattice.
proof_obligations_checked: Two labelled target copies give the correct factor two.
Finite intersection cardinalities exist for arbitrary, possibly infinite pieces.
One-sided boundary inequality has the correct direction.
Square overlap formula handles shifts exceeding the box width.
D6 generators preserve the hexagonal norm and balls.
Affine inverse uses H_R minus r_inverse(t).
Hexagonal size and shell formulas are exact.
R=3D provides positive contradiction gaps, including D=0.
Fixed finite motions are chosen before R.
K7 quotient identification is not duplication.
